product_identifier.identity_rule: Preserve raw value and symbology; validate check digits when applicable; resolve against cached identifiers before research.

asset_tag.identity_rule: A preprinted user label is assigned once to an immutable Entity UUID and remains an identifier alias, not the sole canonical identity.

location_tag.identity_rule: A preprinted user label is assigned once to an immutable Location UUID representing room, shelf, bin, vehicle, container, or another configured location.

evidence_reference.identity_rule: Optional tag may point to a canonical Evidence or Knowledge UUID but never embeds secrets.

location_workflow.assign_location_label: scan unassigned location tag, create/select location, bind printed code to Location UUID
location_workflow.assign_asset_label: scan unassigned asset tag, create/select asset, bind printed code to Entity UUID
location_workflow.move_item: scan destination location then asset tag or product/asset identifier; write one location relationship event with readback
location_workflow.bulk_mode: destination location remains active only for the explicit bounded scan session

rfid_boundary.rule: RFID/NFC presence observations use the same immutable asset/location identities but are not silently converted into barcode-style explicit move events.
